title: Medical Informatics Platform (MIP): A Pilot Study Across Clinical Italian Cohorts.
summary: A distributed clinical informatics platform was assessed across Italian memory-clinic cohorts for Alzheimer-related classification and physician diagnostic confidence.
ai_technology: Methods/Results cover distributed clinical cohorts, ML classification from clinical/CSF/MRI data and physician confidence effects.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A distributed clinical informatics platform was assessed across Italian memory-clinic cohorts for Alzheimer-related classification and physician diagnostic confidence.
evidence.unknown: This was a pilot across the studied Italian memory-clinic cohorts; it does not establish general clinical deployment or improved diagnostic outcomes.
